title: The AI Assistant answers only from the asker's own accepted seats, draws only server-listed links, and cannot be fed history or reached cross-site
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://tracy:tracy@127.0.0.1:51730/postgres node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/assistant.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/chat.test.mjs (any Postgres whose user may create schemas will do; this one is the local stand's).

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail', '# skipped' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "readAskerContext: own accepted seats only"; "readAskerContext: the page hint opens a brief only for a site the asker holds"; "POST /api/assistant/turns: the prompt names A"; "history replays only to the account that wrote it"; "the body cannot carry history or a system message"; "refusals: no session 401"; "mounted in buildApp, a sibling-origin POST is refused"; "a link is clickable only when the server listed its exact address".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 19): the database cases ran, none skipped.

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): the system prompt handed to the model holds the asker's accepted site and none of another account's sites, briefs, or the asker's own brief contact fields; an invitation is counted, not described; a conversation id used by another account replays nothing; `messages`/`history` in the body never reach the model; no session is 401, a burst is 429 RATE_LIMITED, no model is 503 NOT_CONFIGURED; a same-site (sibling origin) POST is 403 while same-origin reaches the door; a link whose address is not exactly in the server's list renders as plain text.
evidence: PR #945, 05/10/2026: the boundary of the assistant is the server, not the prompt; these cases check what the server hands the model and what the widget makes clickable, never what a model chooses to say.
fence: The model has no tools and the request cannot name an account or carry history; links are drawn only from the server's list.

tests: readAskerContext: the page hint opens a brief only for a site the asker holds
history replays only to the account that wrote it
the body cannot carry history or a system message
mounted in buildApp, a sibling-origin POST is refused
a link is clickable only when the server listed its exact address
